comparison.title: Docker-free F5 auto-reload with Azure PostgreSQL
comparison.before_text: The guarded F5 launch could reach Azure but stopped because the working tree required accounts.0032_user_christmas_light_flow.
comparison.after_text: The same profile ran the deployed revision 9d95c54 against Azure without Docker or a migration. The login and readiness endpoints returned HTTP 200 before and after Django reloaded.
